description: List user feedback items from the Mapbox Feedback API with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use this tool to access user-reported issues, suggestions, and feedback about map data, routing, and POI details. Supports comprehensive filtering by status, category, date ranges, trace IDs, and search text. Requires user-feedback:read scope on the access token.

after.description: A cursor from a previous response. Use this to fetch the next page of results.

category.description: Filter by one or more feedback categories

created_after.description: Return items created after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

created_before.description: Return items created before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

feedback_ids.description: Filter by one or more feedback item IDs. At least one must match.

format.description: Output format: "json_string" returns raw JSON data as a JSON string that can be parsed; "formatted_text" returns human-readable text. Both return as text content but json_string contains parseable JSON data while formatted_text is for display.

limit.description: The maximum number of feedback items to return (1-1000)

order.description: The sort direction: asc (ascending, default) or desc (descending)

received_after.description: Return items received by Mapbox after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

received_before.description: Return items received by Mapbox before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

search.description: A search phrase. Returns items where the feedback text contains the phrase.

sort_by.description: The field to sort results by. Options: received_at (default), created_at, or updated_at

status.description: Filter by one or more feedback statuses. Options: received, fixed, reviewed, out_of_scope

trace_id.description: Filter by one or more trace_id values. At least one must match.

updated_after.description: Return items last updated after the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

updated_before.description: Return items last updated before the specified time. Use ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

name: list_feedback_tool
title: List Feedback Tool
